implementation_language.rule_boundary: Vehicle matching, prior-profile inheritance, model-size resolution, learning, validation, and persistence are AFJ rules. JavaScript only renders suggestions and converts touch/input events into API requests.

behavior: A vehicle-number query is normalized without spaces or hyphens and returns at most three saved vehicles from the selected site.
Suggestions are ranked exact match, prefix match, contained match, and then recency; the latest row per normalized plate is returned.
Selecting a saved vehicle fills its latest model and size.
For a new vehicle, entering the model resolves size from the vehicle model table; manual size selection is a correction fallback.
A successfully saved model and size are learned back into the model table for later reuse.

verification.http_security: PASS including unauthenticated favicon 204 and protected operations APIs

deployment.incident: The first restart exposed a legacy-schema migration defect: the conditional ALTER branch did not add plate_number_key before the backfill UPDATE. PM2 entered a rapid restart loop. The service recovered after changing the AFJ migration to independently attempt both ALTER statements and letting the following UPDATE/index statements enforce completeness in the same transaction.
deployment.regression_added: test_phase1_migration.fl now starts with a pre-lookup wash_ops_vehicle_jobs schema and asserts both normalized keys are added and backfilled.
deployment.final_pm2_state: online, stable after recovery; restart counter 1009, unstable restarts 0

production_state: Deployed and verified on local port 40101 and https://care.dclub.kr.
